title: 第236章 铃兰岛下第235章 铃兰岛上
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
莉莉丝坐在甲板角落的木箱上，手里还攥着那根细绳，但这次她没有再往海里扔，以此来钓鱼消遣。
她有一下没一下地拨弄着绳头，目光追着海面上偶尔跃出的飞鱼。
奥菲莉娅安静地靠坐在桅杆阴影处看书，偶尔抬眼看看远处的海平线，又移开。
半日的航行在平静的海面上度过。
海雀号绕过一片浅滩区后，海面上渐渐浮现出灰绿色的岛屿轮廓。
远远望去，整座岛被茂密的植被覆盖，在午后的阳光下泛着温润的绿意，岛屿山势平缓连绵，最高的山峰位于岛中央，确实比周围其他岛屿高出不少。
当海雀号靠上铃兰岛的东侧海滩时，季天能闻到空气中那股清冽的、带着甜意的花香。
淡白色的小花簇拥着从脚下的礁石缝隙中探出头来，一直延伸到山坡上方，漫山遍野。
伊芙琳在船舷边停住，“这就是铃兰岛，我们在这等你们。天黑之前如果没回来，我会让水手带信号灯上山搜索。”
季天跳下船，艾琳娜紧随其后，莉莉丝跟在她身边，奥菲莉娅走在最后。
一行四人踏上岛屿，沿着一条隐约可辨的小径向山坡上方走去。
小半个时辰后，山坡的地势变得陡峭起来，小径开始顺着山脊的走向蜿蜒向上，两侧的植被从低矮的草本植物逐渐过渡为稀疏的灌木。
季天走在最前方，脚步不停。
又走了段路，他在一处较为平缓的山坡上停下脚步，发现了异常：
前方不远处的几棵歪斜的古树下横着几只灰黑色的木箱，表面布满裂纹与青苔，边缘被潮湿的海风侵蚀得有些变形，整体轮廓完整。
其中两只木箱的盖子掀开一条缝，隐约露出底下闪闪的金光。
“哇！这是宝箱！？”
她刚要去将宝箱打开，看看里面有什么东西，便被季天一把拉住。
“等等，这不是一般的宝箱。”
季天走近几步，伸脚在最近的木箱侧面轻轻踢了一下。

那只木箱的盖子猛然弹开，从里面探出一团灰褐色的东西，看起来就像是某种用破布和废弃木料拼凑而成的生物。
它有两只大小不一的纽扣眼睛，圆圆的，正一眨不眨地望着季天，嘴里发出“咔哒咔哒”的轻响。
莉莉丝往后退了半步：“这是……宝箱怪？！可魔王城的宝箱怪不长这样啊？”
魔王城的宝箱怪是危险的拟态生物，捕食者，有着锋利的齿和快速闭合的盖子。
而眼前这一只，纽扣做的眼睛，破布拼凑的身体，木头和麻绳随意组装的四肢，动作缓慢而笨拙，看起来是只要做些什么但始终反应慢半拍的幼崽。
季天蹲下身，伸手在那只宝箱怪头顶轻轻按了下。
那只生物先是缩了一下，然后慢慢从箱子里探出更多身体，用触手碰了碰季天的指尖。
“咔哒。”
这大概率是被人驯化的，始作俑者应该是初代勇者。
他从魔王城带来的宝箱怪，在这里放养了几千年，繁衍了不知道多少代，野性全褪了。
莉莉丝小心翼翼地凑近，试探着伸出手，碰了碰其中一只宝箱怪的边缘：
“它不会咬我吧？！”
莉莉丝小时候其实被魔王城里的宝箱怪吓过来着，那里的宝箱怪都很凶悍，动不动就咬魔族。
“不会，你要是怕被咬，别摸它嘴巴就行。”
季天站起身，又看了一眼那几只散落在古树间的宝箱怪，“留着吧，它们不挡路。”
content_en:
Lilith sat on the wooden box in the corner of the deck, still holding the string in her hand, but this time she did not throw it into the sea again to fish for fun.
She fiddled with the end of the rope constantly, her eyes chasing the flying fish that occasionally jumped out of the sea.
Ophelia sat quietly in the shadow of the mast reading a book, occasionally raising her eyes to look at the horizon in the distance, and then moving away.
Half a day's sailing was spent on calm seas.
After the Puffin rounded a shoal area, the outline of a gray-green island gradually appeared on the sea.
From a distance, the entire island is covered with dense vegetation, glowing with warm greenery in the afternoon sun. The island has gentle and continuous mountains. The highest peak is located in the center of the island, which is indeed much higher than other surrounding islands.
When the Puffin docked on the east beach of Sudley Island, Ji Tian could smell the crisp, sweet floral fragrance in the air.
Clusters of pale white flowers poked their heads out from the cracks in the rocks at their feet, extending all the way to the top of the hillside, all over the mountains and plains.
Evelin stopped at the side of the ship, "This is Lily of the Valley Island, we are waiting for you here. If you don't come back before dark, I will ask the sailors to go up the mountain with a signal light to search."
Ji Tian jumped off the boat, Elena followed closely, Lilith followed her, and Ophelia came last.
A group of four people stepped onto the island and walked up the hillside along a vaguely identifiable path.
Less than half an hour later, the terrain of the hillside became steeper, and the trail began to wind up along the ridge. The vegetation on both sides gradually transitioned from low herbaceous plants to sparse shrubs.
Ji Tian walked at the front without stopping.
After walking for a while, he stopped on a relatively gentle hillside and discovered something unusual:
There are several gray-black wooden boxes lying horizontally under some crooked old trees not far ahead. The surface is covered with cracks and moss, and the edges are somewhat deformed by the moist sea breeze, but the overall outline is intact.
The lids of two of the wooden boxes were opened a crack, vaguely revealing the glittering gold underneath.
"Wow! Is this a treasure chest!?"
Just as she was about to open the treasure chest to see what was inside, she was grabbed by Ji Tian.
"Wait a minute, this is not an ordinary treasure chest."
Ji Tian took a few steps closer, stretched out his foot and lightly kicked the side of the nearest wooden box.
The lid of the wooden box suddenly popped open, and a gray-brown mass protruded from the inside. It looked like some kind of creature made of rags and discarded wood.
It had two button eyes of different sizes, which were round and looking at Ji Tian without blinking, making a soft "click-click" sound from its mouth.
Lilith took half a step back: "Is this...a Mimic Monster?! But don't the Mimic Monsters in Demon King City look like this?"
Mimics in Demon King's City are dangerous mimics, predators with sharp teeth and quick-closing lids.
The one in front of me has eyes made of buttons, a body made of rags, and limbs randomly assembled from wood and hemp rope. Its movements are slow and clumsy. It looks like a cub that only needs to do something but is always slow to respond.
Ji Tian knelt down, stretched out his hand and pressed lightly on the top of the Mimic's head.
The creature shrank first, then slowly stretched out more of its body from the box, and touched Ji Tian's fingertips with its tentacles.
"Click."
There is a high probability that this was domesticated, and the initiator should be the first generation of brave men.
The Mimic Monsters he brought from the Demon King's City have been kept here for thousands of years. They have reproduced for countless generations, and their wild nature has completely faded.
Lilith cautiously approached, tentatively stretched out her hand, and touched the edge of one of the Mimics:
"It won't bite me, will it?!"
When Lilith was a child, she was actually frightened by the Mimic Monsters in the Demon King's City. The Mimic Monsters there were very fierce and would bite the Demons at every turn.
"No, if you're afraid of being bitten, just don't touch its mouth."
Ji Tian stood up and took another look at the Mimic Monsters scattered among the ancient trees. "Keep them, they won't block the way."
